summary: Backend-only testing for Futbase / Liga Alevín. Built pytest regression suite (/app/backend/tests/) covering all requested features: auth (coach/parent, register-coach, login, me, register-parent 404 on bad code, forgot-password generic response, reset-password 400 on invalid token), /seed (coach only, parent 403), /config GET+PUT (parent 403), /club/invite, teams CRUD + parent 403, matches CRUD + bulk + /standings (points/DG/sort validation) + /jornada-dates GET/PUT, players CRUD + stats increment (accumulation verified), /upload + /files/{path} roundtrip against Emergent object storage, /scan/matches and /scan/teams (Gemini via Emergent LLM key, structure validated), and role enforcement on all write endpoints. 32/32 tests PASS (100%). JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml.

minor.issue: Inserts a password_reset_requests document BEFORE the per-email rate-limit check, so the limiter counts its own insert; the throttle fires at 5 total requests in 15 min (effectively ratelimit=5), which is still safe but off-by-one from intent. Also, if email dispatch fails (Resend 4xx/5xx), the token stays valid in DB; non-blocking since response is generic by design.
Does not validate uploaded content-type / size; any extension would be accepted (file.filename rsplit). Not blocking but worth constraining.
Public (no auth). Any user with the path can download the image. Acceptable for crests/avatars but worth noting for private uploads.

action_items: No fixes required for the tested surface area. Backend is green on all 14 feature items in the review request.
(Optional) Consider rate-limiting /auth/forgot-password BEFORE insert, enforce upload content-type/size limits, and gate /api/files/{path} behind auth if private media is expected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 749 lines — above the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers: auth.py, config.py, teams.py, matches.py, players.py, uploads.py, scan.py, email.py.
requests library used for storage I/O inside async endpoints is correctly wrapped in run_in_threadpool for upload/download, good.
Pydantic models expose equipo_id as part of request body (Optional); server overwrites it from the authenticated user — safe but confusing; consider separate Create vs Response schemas.

scan/matches and scan/teams use Gemini model 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview' — ensure this model id remains valid for emergentintegrations; endpoints currently respond 200 with empty lists when text is unreadable, which is the agreed contract.
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} across endpoints.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed was called via the suite as the coach, populating teams (8), players (8), matches (jornadas 1-4) and jornada_dates. Also created transient TEST_* teams/players/matches which the suite cleans up (team/match/player CRUD tests delete their own data; bulk-created TEST_Alpha/Beta/Gamma/Delta/H/A teams remain, prefixed TEST_ for easy identification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py. Coach account coach@test.com/test123 is seeded via register-coach if missing. BASE_URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env (currently https://futbase-7-11-mobile.preview.emergentagent.com). Image upload and Gemini scan both work end-to-end against Emergent storage and Emergent LLM. For future frontend tests use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and testID attributes.
